**q25** Engine: CEL (`github.com/google/cel-go`) wrapped by the in-repo `filter` package — `internal/filter/engine.go` (`Engine`, `NewEngine`, `Compile`), schema in `internal/filter/schema.go`, IR in `internal/filter/ir.go`. Mechanism: the CEL expression is compiled into a dialect-agnostic `Condition` tree, then `internal/filter/render.go` renders it to a parameterized SQL `WHERE` fragment for the requested `DialectName` (`DialectSQLite`/`DialectPostgres`/`DialectMySQL`), which each driver appends via `filter.AppendConditions` (`internal/filter/helpers.go:9`) in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:69`. API-level validation lives in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_filter.go`.

**q27** Mechanism: the built `web/dist` output is copied into `server/router/frontend/dist` and compiled into the binary with Go `embed.FS`, then served by Echo's static middleware with SPA fallback to `index.html`. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21` (`//go:embed dist/*`), `:41-80` (`FrontendService.Serve`), invoked from `server/server.go:70`.

**q28**
```
s3presign Runner — RunOnce at startup, then a 12h time.Ticker (server/server.go:158-166; server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-41)
```
That is the only runner started. Unused infrastructure: `internal/scheduler` (cron-style scheduler with parser/jobs/middleware) has **no** references anywhere outside its own package/tests; and `server/runner/memopayload`'s `Runner`/`NewRunner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:14-24`) is never instantiated — only the package-level `RebuildMemoPayload` helper is used (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:18`).

**q29** Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:151-186`, installed on the Connect transport at `web/src/connect.ts:188-193`. Tokens it manages: a JWT **access token** sent as `Authorization: Bearer …` (stored/expiry-checked in `web/src/auth-state.ts`, localStorage) and a **refresh token** held in an HttpOnly cookie (`credentials: "include"`, `web/src/connect.ts:57-61`), refreshed via `AuthService.refreshToken` on a separate transport (`web/src/connect.ts:65-89`); also personal access tokens are accepted as bearer tokens server-side. Backend validation package: `server/auth` (`authenticator.go` — `Authenticate`, `resolveBearer`, `AuthenticateByRefreshToken`, `AuthenticateByPAT`; `token.go` — `ParseAccessTokenV2`, `ParseRefreshToken`), driven by the Connect `NewAuthInterceptor`/`Authorizer` in `server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go` and `server/router/api/v1/authz.go`.
